author: CNN
description: Ghislaine Maxwell, who was sentenced to prison for 20 years for conspiring with Jeffrey Epstein to abuse minors, sent a clear message to Donald Trump that if the president were to grant her clemency, she would clear his name of any wrongdoing as it pertains to Epstein. Trump has not ruled out the possibility of offering Maxwell a pardon or commutation.
title: Attorney: Maxwell could clear Trump in Epstein probe for clemency

description: Japan’s ruling party just secured a historic election victory, powered in large part by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s popularity. description: 78‑year‑old pro‑democracy media tycoon Jimmy Lai, long seen as one of Beijing’s most outspoken critics, has been sentenced to 20 years in prison in Hong Kong’s highest‑profile national security case, capping a years‑long legal battle that has drawn global condemnation. author: CNN
description: Daye Gottsche and her friend helped Jake Lang, a pardoned far-right activist and January 6 Rioter, flee a crowd that was chasing him through Minneapolis.  Now knowing who he is, she says she still would have helped him, though she is not sure he would do the same for her. “I feel no one deserves that type of treatment,” she said. “Like, you don’t deserve to die or be brutally beaten for your views — politically or religiously.” #minneapolis #cnn
title: Hear the message a trans woman had for a far-right activist after she helped him
